# descope_docebo_connector (Resource)

Manages a Docebo connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Get user information from Docebo in your Descope user journeys with the Docebo connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) The Docebo api base url.
- `client_id` (String) The Docebo OAuth 2.0 app client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The Docebo OAuth 2.0 app client secret.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The Docebo user's password.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `username` (String) The Docebo username.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
